inputs.label: Homeworld data files (optional, for the full campaign)
inputs.help: Homeworld.big, HW_Music.wxd and HW_Comp.vce from your own Homeworld. The Remastered Collection's Homeworld1Classic/Data folder has them. Without them you can play the demo.

steps.why: The game reads the full-campaign data files from Download. The guide has the user allow All files access in the headset.

steps.text: Open Homeworld Unbound from Library > Unknown Sources. If it asks for All files access, allow it and start the game again. With the data files in Download it starts the full campaign; without them it plays the demo. To update later, install over the top. Do not uninstall first, or your saves are deleted.

notes: The payload targetPath (Android/data/org.homeworldunbound.game/files/) disagrees with the guide, which pushes the three files to /sdcard/Download/ after granting All files access. This recipe follows the guide. The 1.05 demo ships in the APK. The repository also has a python install.py that does the same.
